text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: We've cornered them! But it seems like they don't intend to give up yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いよいよ追い詰めたッス！
でも、
向こうはまだ諦めるつもりはないみたいッスね。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: We've given them enough time to consider surrender. From here on, it's time for a delightful punishment♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
既に、
降伏を検討する猶予は十二分に与えた。
ならばここから先は、
愉しいお仕置きの時間というわけだ♪

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: As villains, they should resist until the end. I'll crush that big thing, the hope and regrets, so they can't regret anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪役なら悪役らしく、
最後まで悪足掻きしてみせろ。
頼りの綱のそのデカブツごと、
後悔も心残りもできないほどに打ち砕いてやるとも。
